note: media_gallery_migration is a submodule of media_gallery that imports Drupal 7 Media 7.x-1.x galleries. It ships three migrate_plus.migration config entities (group media_gallery, all enforced by media_gallery_migration): d7_media_gallery_files (source d7_media_gallery_file -> entity:file), d7_media_gallery_media (source d7_media_gallery_file -> entity:media bundle image), d7_media_gallery_entity (source d7_node node_type media_gallery -> entity:media_gallery; images sub_process reads source 'media_gallery_media'). It provides one migrate source plugin d7_media_gallery_file (MediaGalleryFile extends DrupalSqlBase, source_module file) that reads file_managed and in prepareRow filters to gallery files via the D7 table field_data_media_gallery_media (column media_gallery_media_fid) -- this table is the only meaningful difference from media_gallery_migration2. Depends on media_gallery, migrate, migrate_drupal, migrate_plus, migrate_tools. No permissions, no config schema, no own Drush commands (use migrate_tools). source.constants.source_base_path defaults to the placeholder http://d7media.docksal.site. Because it shares migration ids with media_gallery_migration2, only one can be enabled at once. Medium cases enable the submodule and read the live migration config; hard cases start from the submodule uninstalled (migrations absent) and require enabling it so the migration config entities become registered on the live site, verified against config.

evals.prompt: The media_gallery_migration submodule ships some migrations. What are the migration ids it defines, and what migration group are they in?
evals.expected_output: It defines three migrate_plus migrations in the migration group 'media_gallery': d7_media_gallery_files (-> file), d7_media_gallery_media (-> media, bundle image), and d7_media_gallery_entity (D7 media_gallery nodes -> media_gallery entities). Effective order is files -> media -> entity.

evals.prompt: In the media_gallery_migration submodule, what is the id of the custom migrate source plugin, and which Drupal 7 database table does it read to get the raw records?
evals.expected_output: The source plugin id is d7_media_gallery_file (class MediaGalleryFile extends DrupalSqlBase). Its query() reads the D7 file_managed table; prepareRow() then keeps only files that belong to a gallery by looking them up in field_data_media_gallery_media (column media_gallery_media_fid).

evals.prompt: Before running the media_gallery_migration migrations against a real Drupal 7 site, which source setting must you change so the file migration can fetch the original files?
evals.expected_output: You must change source.constants.source_base_path (it defaults to the placeholder http://d7media.docksal.site) to your real D7 site's public base URL/path, and register the legacy D7 database as the 'migrate' source connection. Then run via migrate_tools: drush migrate:import --group=media_gallery.

evals.prompt: The media_gallery_migration submodule is enabled on this site. Inspect the live configuration and list the migration id(s) it registered in the media_gallery migration group.
evals.expected_output: The live site has migrate_plus.migration.d7_media_gallery_files, .d7_media_gallery_media and .d7_media_gallery_entity (migration_group media_gallery), each enforced by media_gallery_migration. Discoverable via drush config listing (e.g. \Drupal::configFactory()->listAll('migrate_plus.migration.d7_media_gallery')).

evals.prompt: On this site the media_gallery_migration submodule is enabled. Inspect the live migrate_plus.migration.d7_media_gallery_entity configuration and report which source property the 'images' field is built from (the sub_process source).
evals.expected_output: In d7_media_gallery_entity, process.images is a sub_process whose source is 'media_gallery_media' (with a migration_lookup on d7_media_gallery_media). This is the Media 7.x-1.x property name, discoverable via drush config:get migrate_plus.migration.d7_media_gallery_entity process.images.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has the media_gallery module but its Drupal 7 gallery migrations are not currently available. Using the media_gallery_migration submodule, make the D7 gallery migrations available on the live site (so the d7_media_gallery_entity migration is registered).
evals.expected_output: Enable the submodule (drush en media_gallery_migration -y), which installs its enforced migration config. Afterwards migrate_plus.migration.d7_media_gallery_entity exists with source.plugin d7_node and dependencies.enforced.module including media_gallery_migration.

evals.prompt: On this site, ensure the media_gallery_migration submodule's D7 file import migration is registered live: after your change, the d7_media_gallery_files migration (which uses the custom d7_media_gallery_file source plugin) must exist in the site configuration.
evals.expected_output: Enable the submodule (drush en media_gallery_migration -y). Then migrate_plus.migration.d7_media_gallery_files exists with source.plugin d7_media_gallery_file and dependencies.enforced.module including media_gallery_migration.
